name: New Zealand spinach

schedule.notes: Soak seeds 24 hours — hard coats. Or nick with a file.
Pinch top 3 to 4 in of stems with leaves. Continuous harvest keeps it producing.

harvest.cues: Stem tips with 4 to 6 leaves. Plant becomes bitter if not picked regularly.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 3 to 5 days. Cooked tastes nearly identical to spinach; raw is slightly salty-tinged.

notes: Not a true spinach but cooks like one. Hot-weather substitute when real spinach bolts. Sprawls 3 to 4 ft — give it space or let it ramble through tomato beds as living mulch. Contains oxalates; cook briefly to reduce.
